second_root_cause: My hand-written contracts never carried the _COMMON.md reporting block, so no lane of mine emitted NEXT_BOTTLENECK - the one field harvest() mines to generate the next autonomous target.

evidence._COMMON.md_line_63: NEXT_BOTTLENECK: <what is now the top cost, with its measured ns>
evidence.daemon_behaviour: generate_targets() prepends _COMMON.md to every AUTO-GENERATED brief, so daemon-launched lanes would feed the loop correctly
evidence.my_contracts: used CLAIM/STATUS/EVIDENCE/ACTION/UNRESOLVED, later ACCEPTANCE/VERIFY/EDIT - never the reporting block
evidence.result: ~20 excellent lane results today, zero of which advanced the autonomous queue

both_ends_starved: reclaim_safe.sh deleted the reports (fixed this turn), AND the surviving reports carried nothing harvestable. Either alone would have stopped the loop.
the_standing_fix: Every contract ends with the _COMMON.md reporting block, or at minimum NEXT_BOTTLENECK with its measured ns. Recorded as REPLAN R010.
why_this_matters_beyond_today: G011 asks whether the pipeline keeps making progress in my absence. A lane that finishes without naming the next wall is a dead end for the loop even when its own work is excellent - and today proves the two are independent. The Q80 work was a 12.3x improvement and fed the autonomous queue nothing.
